This topic is part of the CCEA GCSE Music specification.

Component 2: Composing appears in the assessment, so it's worth knowing well.

You'll meet Component 2: Composing in exam questions and need to apply your knowledge.

The CCEA board expects you to understand both the concepts and how to use them.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Component 2: Composing.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.
